name: swiftblade_vindicator_tramples_over_a_blocker_already_dealt_lethal
notes: CR 702.19b: lethal damage counts the damage already marked. Swiftblade Vindicator (1/1 double strike, vigilance, trample) is blocked by an indestructible 0/1 wall. First-strike step: its 1 damage must go to the wall, its lethal damage (a one-word menu, not asked). Regular step: the wall survived with lethal damage marked, so none more is needed: the menu runs from 0, and the division's default (the blocker's lethal damage) sends the 1 damage over to seat 1. Found by the engine wave E2 review: the wall had to take 1 again.
